drill-down: GET /api/v1/accounts/{id}/ledger and an editable ledger drawer (post/unpost/edit/void, 422 when unbalanced)

defects_found_and_fixed_in_this_cycle: The Windows PDF engine refused the logo: the bundled-resource allowlist admitted only font files, so the document fell back to HTML silently. Exactly the VIRA logo data URI is now allowed and every other address is still refused.
Printable documents printed a Latin date (1405/08/09) next to Persian amounts; persian.jalali() now returns Persian digits (۱۴۰۵/۰۸/۰۹) with the raw ISO value only as a fallback.
Account codes were printed with a thousands separator (۱٬۰۱۰); a code is not an amount.

backend/openapi.json carried one trailing newline the CI regeneration never writes, so the contract job compared raw bytes and failed; the file was regenerated with the exact CI script and a test now locks the bytes.

The native in-app upgrade gate read the pinned published 1.0.9 payload out of the delta cache, which only holds the three most recent tags; 1.0.9 left that window with 1.0.13 and the tag run failed 24 s in. The payload is now restored by its pinned digest.

That same gate then had no 1.0.9 delta to apply, because the release ships three direct deltas (from 1.0.10, 1.0.11, 1.0.12). A gate-only delta is generated into RUNNER_TEMP with the same generator, so the real old-client upgrade stays covered and latest.json/SHA256SUMS keep exactly the packaged assets.
The gate step uploaded no diagnostics when it failed before the Playwright audit; the step output and a crash report are now always uploaded and also emitted as annotations.
